title: Special meeting authorizes closed session on land matters
subtitle: Brief meeting with no public business; no video recording because of technical difficulties.
overview: City Council held a short special meeting chaired by the Mayor. According to the minutes, it began at 1:13 p.m. and adjourned at 1:15 p.m. No one declared a pecuniary interest, and the Mayor had no updates to share.

The only motion was to hold a closed (in-camera) meeting right after the special meeting. Council agreed {{vote:m1}}. The closed session was authorized to consider four matters: two about land disposition and solicitor-client privilege, one about a land acquisition and instructions for negotiation, and one about a land acquisition and disposition. These fall under the Municipal Act, 2001, sections 239 (c), (f) and (k).

For residents, this meeting made no public policy decisions. The minutes do not report any outcomes from the closed session. Because of technical difficulties, no video recording of the meeting exists, and no transcript was available, so the public record is limited to the minutes.

decisions.detail: Council authorized an in-camera meeting right after the special meeting to consider four land-related and legal matters under the Municipal Act, 2001 {{vote:m1}}.
